1	"""Core service surface for StreamMill.
2	
3	The frozen baseline only reports process health; that surface stays
4	unchanged. On top of it this module now implements named event-time
5	tumbling windows with explicit watermarks:
6	
7	* streams are created with a positive ``window_ms`` and a non-negative
8	  ``allowed_lateness_ms``;
9	* events carry an integer ``timestamp_ms`` and a finite numeric ``value``
10	  and land in the left-closed, right-open window
11	  ``[floor(timestamp_ms / window_ms) * window_ms, +window_ms)``;
12	* a per-stream watermark only moves forward; once it reaches
13	  ``window_end_ms + allowed_lateness_ms`` the window is final, is
14	  emitted exactly once, and is retained for queries;
15	* events with ``timestamp_ms < watermark - allowed_lateness_ms`` are
16	  acknowledged but dropped without touching the aggregates.
17	
18	Streams may optionally be created with a positive ``slide_ms`` (no
19	larger than ``window_ms`` and dividing it evenly). Such streams use
20	fixed-step overlapping sliding windows: an accepted event at timestamp
21	``t`` is counted once in every window ``[start, start + window_ms)``
22	whose ``start`` is an integer multiple of ``slide_ms`` and satisfies
23	``start <= t < start + window_ms`` (negative timestamps follow the same
24	mathematical grid). Every window still finalizes independently once the
25	watermark reaches its own ``window_end_ms + allowed_lateness_ms`` and is
26	emitted exactly once, ordered by window start. Without ``slide_ms`` the
27	stream is the plain tumbling stream above and every public shape is
28	unchanged.
29	
30	Streams may optionally enable event-id deduplication by passing a
31	positive ``dedup_retention_ms`` (no smaller than ``allowed_lateness_ms``)
32	at creation time. On such streams every event must carry a non-empty
33	string ``event_id``:
34	
35	* the first occurrence of an id is aggregated and remembered together
36	  with its ``timestamp_ms`` and ``value``;
37	* an exact retry (same ``timestamp_ms`` and numerically equal ``value``)
38	  is reported as ``duplicate: true`` and never touches the aggregates —
39	  the dedup check runs before the lateness check, so retained retries
40	  are duplicates even past the lateness horizon;
41	* the same id with a different timestamp or value is rejected with
42	  ``event_id_conflict`` and leaves all state untouched;
43	* an unseen id that arrives too late is dropped as usual and its id is
44	  not remembered.
45	
46	Remembered ids are evicted once the watermark advances past
47	``timestamp_ms + dedup_retention_ms`` (ids exactly on the boundary are
48	kept); evicted ids may be reused and are treated as new events.
49	
50	Streams created with a non-negative ``auto_watermark_lag_ms`` track the
51	maximum ``timestamp_ms`` of every successfully accepted event. After an
52	event is aggregated (and its id registered, when deduplicating) the
53	watermark advances atomically to
54	``max(current_watermark, max_event_timestamp - auto_watermark_lag_ms)``;
55	the lateness/dedup decision for that event uses the watermark as it was
56	before the advance. Dropped, duplicate or conflicting events never move
57	the maximum event timestamp or the watermark. Manual watermark posts keep
58	working on automatic streams and subsequent automatic advances never
59	regress below a manual watermark. Event responses on automatic streams
60	additionally carry the post-processing ``watermark_ms`` (``null`` until a
61	watermark exists) and the windows finalized by that response.
62	
63	A portable full-state snapshot is available through
64	``Service.snapshot`` / ``Service.restore_snapshot``: export produces a
65	self-contained JSON document (``format_version`` 1) capturing config,
66	watermark, open windows, finalized results and retained dedup records;
67	automatic streams additionally carry ``auto_watermark_lag_ms`` and
68	``max_event_timestamp_ms``; sliding streams additionally carry
69	``slide_ms`` (a document without it restores as a tumbling stream).
70	Restore is only accepted on an instance
71	without any streams, validates the document strictly (never silently
72	repairing it) and publishes the whole state atomically.
73	
74	In-process dimension tables provide the lookup side of an optional
75	current-value stream-table join:
76	
77	* ``POST /tables`` creates a named table; rows are written with
78	  ``PUT``-style upserts of non-empty string ``key``/``label`` pairs and
79	  report whether the stored label actually ``changed``;
80	* a stream may be created with ``lookup_table`` naming an existing
81	  table. Events on such a stream must carry a non-empty ``lookup_key``;
82	  after the usual dedup and lateness decisions the current label is read
83	  atomically (an unknown key is rejected with ``lookup_key_not_found``
84	  and leaves all state untouched) and the event is aggregated both into
85	  the plain windows and into per-window ``(lookup_key, label)`` groups.
86	  Later table writes only affect later events. Dedup records on joined
87	  streams include the ``lookup_key``, so resubmitting an id with a
88	  different key is an ``event_id_conflict``;
89	* joined groups finalize together with their window and are exposed
90	  through ``Service.joined_results``, ordered by window start, lookup
91	  key and label.
92	
93	Snapshots export as ``format_version`` 2 (adding ``tables`` plus
94	``lookup_table``/``joined_windows``/``joined_finalized`` on joined
95	streams) whenever any table exists, and restore stays compatible with
96	version 1 documents. When the join is unused every public shape and the
97	version 1 snapshot are unchanged.
98	
99	Streams may optionally materialize a window change feed by passing a
100	positive ``change_retention`` at creation time (echoed in the create
101	response; without it the stream behaves exactly as before). On such
102	streams every state change is published as a totally ordered sequence of
103	records, numbered by a ``seq`` that starts at 1 and never regresses:
104	
105	* every successfully aggregated event appends one ``upsert`` record per
106	  affected base window (ascending by window start on sliding streams),
107	  carrying the post-event ``count``/``sum`` of that window;
108	* every watermark advance that finalizes windows appends one ``final``
109	  record per newly finalized window (ascending by window start) with the
110	  final aggregates — on automatic streams the upserts of the triggering
111	  event always precede the finals of the resulting advance, and an
112	  advance without newly finalized windows appends nothing;
113	* duplicates, too-late drops, conflicts, unknown lookup keys and
114	  validation failures never consume a sequence number, and joined
115	  streams publish only the base-window changes.
116	
117	``Service.changes`` returns the retained records with ``seq`` greater
118	than a cursor, ascending, together with the current ``latest_seq``.
119	Only the newest ``change_retention`` records are kept (older ones are
120	trimmed after every commit, without moving ``latest_seq``); a cursor
121	past ``latest_seq`` raises ChangeCursorAheadError and a cursor that has
122	fallen behind the oldest retained record raises
123	ChangeCursorExpiredError.
124	
125	Instances with at least one change-feed stream export snapshots as
126	``format_version`` 3, which always carries the ``tables`` array and, on
127	enabled streams, ``change_retention``/``latest_seq``/``changes``.
128	Restore validates the retained records strictly (sequence continuity
129	against ``latest_seq`` and the retention cap, ordering, window
130	alignment, and the last retained record of every window against the
131	aggregated state) and publishes the feed so the cursor and the next
132	sequence number continue exactly as on the uninterrupted instance.
133	Version 1 and 2 documents restore as before, and instances without a
134	change feed keep exporting their original versions and shapes.
135	
136	Disk persistence remains out of scope.
137	"""

215	class _Stream:
216	    """Mutable state of one named stream. Guarded by the Service lock."""
217	
218	    def __init__(
219	        self,
220	        name: str,
221	        window_ms: int,
222	        allowed_lateness_ms: int,
223	        dedup_retention_ms: int | None = None,
224	        auto_watermark_lag_ms: int | None = None,
225	        slide_ms: int | None = None,
226	        lookup_table: str | None = None,
227	        change_retention: int | None = None,
228	    ) -> None:
229	        self.name = name
230	        self.window_ms = window_ms
231	        self.allowed_lateness_ms = allowed_lateness_ms
232	        self.dedup_retention_ms = dedup_retention_ms
233	        self.auto_watermark_lag_ms = auto_watermark_lag_ms
234	        # None selects the tumbling grid (step == window_ms); otherwise the
235	        # stream is sliding with this fixed, evenly-dividing step.
236	        self.slide_ms = slide_ms
237	        # Name of the dimension table this stream joins against, if any.
238	        self.lookup_table = lookup_table
239	        # Maximum number of retained change-feed records; None disables
240	        # the feed entirely.
241	        self.change_retention = change_retention
242	        self.watermark: int | None = None
243	        # Maximum timestamp_ms of a successfully accepted event; only
244	        # maintained on automatic streams, None until the first such event.
245	        self.max_event_timestamp: int | None = None
246	        # window_start_ms -> [count, sum]; only non-empty windows exist.
247	        self._windows: dict[int, list] = {}
248	        self._finalized: list[dict] = []
249	        self._finalized_starts: set[int] = set()
250	        # event_id -> (timestamp_ms, value) for accepted, not yet evicted
251	        # ids; joined streams append the lookup_key to the tuple.
252	        self._dedup: dict[str, tuple] = {}
253	        # Joined streams only: window_start_ms -> (lookup_key, label) ->
254	        # [count, sum] for open windows, plus the finalized group rows in
255	        # results order (window start, lookup_key, label).
256	        self._joined_windows: dict[int, dict[tuple[str, str], list]] = {}
257	        self._joined_finalized: list[dict] = []
258	        # Change feed: the next record gets _latest_seq + 1; _changes
259	        # holds at most change_retention records, oldest first.
260	        self._latest_seq = 0
261	        self._changes: list[dict] = []
262	
263	    @property
264	    def _step_ms(self) -> int:
265	        """Grid spacing: slide_ms for sliding streams, else window_ms."""
266	        return self.slide_ms if self.slide_ms is not None else self.window_ms
267	
268	    def _window_starts(self, timestamp_ms: int) -> list[int]:
269	        """Starts of every grid window covering ``timestamp_ms``.
270	
271	        Windows are ``[start, start + window_ms)`` with ``start`` on the
272	        grid of multiples of the step; the floor division keeps the same
273	        boundaries for negative timestamps. The list is ascending, which
274	        is also the finalization/results order.
275	        """
276	        step = self._step_ms
277	        last = (timestamp_ms // step) * step
278	        first = last - (self.window_ms - step)
279	        return list(range(first, last + 1, step))
280	
281	    def add_event(
282	        self,
283	        timestamp_ms: int,
284	        value: float,
285	        event_id: str | None = None,
286	        lookup_key: str | None = None,
287	        label_of=None,
288	    ) -> dict:
289	        """Process one event against the pre-event watermark.
290	
291	        On automatic streams every response additionally carries the
292	        post-processing ``watermark_ms`` (``None`` until a watermark exists)
293	        and the ``finalized`` windows produced by this response; duplicate
294	        and dropped events leave the watermark untouched and finalize
295	        nothing. Accepted-event bookkeeping (maximum event timestamp plus
296	        the resulting monotone watermark advance) only runs after
297	        aggregation and dedup registration.
298	
299	        On joined streams the current label for ``lookup_key`` is read
300	        through ``label_of`` after the dedup and lateness decisions but
301	        before any state mutation, so an unknown key raises
302	        LookupKeyNotFoundError with all state untouched. The dedup check
303	        includes the lookup key: an exact retry repeats timestamp, value
304	        and key, while the same id with a different key conflicts.
305	        """
306	        automatic = self.auto_watermark_lag_ms is not None
307	        joined = self.lookup_table is not None
308	        if self.dedup_retention_ms is not None:
309	            retained = self._dedup.get(event_id)
310	            if retained is not None:
311	                same = retained[0] == timestamp_ms and retained[1] == value
312	                if joined:
313	                    same = same and retained[2] == lookup_key
314	                if same:
315	                    outcome: dict = {"dropped": False, "duplicate": True}
316	                    if automatic:
317	                        outcome.update(watermark_ms=self.watermark, finalized=[])
318	                    return outcome
319	                raise EventIdConflictError(event_id)
320	            if self._is_too_late(timestamp_ms):
321	                # Unseen too-late ids are dropped without being remembered.
322	                outcome = {"dropped": True, "duplicate": False}
323	                if automatic:
324	                    outcome.update(watermark_ms=self.watermark, finalized=[])
325	                return outcome
326	            label = self._resolve_label(label_of, lookup_key)
327	            self._aggregate(timestamp_ms, value, lookup_key, label)
328	            self._dedup[event_id] = (
329	                (timestamp_ms, value, lookup_key)
330	                if joined
331	                else (timestamp_ms, value)
332	            )
333	            outcome = {"dropped": False, "duplicate": False}
334	        else:
335	            if self._is_too_late(timestamp_ms):
336	                outcome = {"dropped": True}
337	                if automatic:
338	                    outcome.update(watermark_ms=self.watermark, finalized=[])
339	                return outcome
340	            label = self._resolve_label(label_of, lookup_key)
341	            self._aggregate(timestamp_ms, value, lookup_key, label)
342	            outcome = {"dropped": False}
343	        if automatic:
344	            newly = self._note_accepted_event(timestamp_ms)
345	            outcome.update(watermark_ms=self.watermark, finalized=newly)
346	        return outcome
347	
348	    def _resolve_label(self, label_of, lookup_key: str | None):
349	        """Read the current label for a joined event, or None on plain streams."""
350	        if self.lookup_table is None:
351	            return None
352	        return label_of(lookup_key)
353	
354	    def _is_too_late(self, timestamp_ms: int) -> bool:
355	        return (
356	            self.watermark is not None
357	            and timestamp_ms < self.watermark - self.allowed_lateness_ms
358	        )
359	
360	    def _note_accepted_event(self, timestamp_ms: int) -> list[dict]:
361	        """Advance the max event timestamp and then the watermark."""
362	        if (
363	            self.max_event_timestamp is None
364	            or timestamp_ms > self.max_event_timestamp
365	        ):
366	            self.max_event_timestamp = timestamp_ms
367	        target = self.max_event_timestamp - self.auto_watermark_lag_ms
368	        if self.watermark is None or target > self.watermark:
369	            # Publish through the shared path so finalization and dedup
370	            # eviction behave exactly like a manual advance.
371	            return self.advance_watermark(target)
372	        return []
373	
374	    def _aggregate(
375	        self,
376	        timestamp_ms: int,
377	        value: float,
378	        lookup_key: str | None = None,
379	        label: str | None = None,
380	    ) -> None:
381	        for start in self._window_starts(timestamp_ms):
382	            bucket = self._windows.setdefault(start, [0, 0])
383	            bucket[0] += 1
384	            bucket[1] += value
385	            # Base-window upsert with the post-event aggregates; sliding
386	            # streams publish one record per window, ascending by start.
387	            self._append_change("upsert", start, bucket[0], bucket[1])
388	            if self.lookup_table is not None:
389	                groups = self._joined_windows.setdefault(start, {})
390	                group = groups.setdefault((lookup_key, label), [0, 0])
391	                group[0] += 1
392	                group[1] += value
393	
394	    def _append_change(self, kind: str, start: int, count: int, total: float) -> None:
395	        """Publish one change-feed record and trim to the retention cap.
396	
397	        Sequence numbers are handed out consecutively from 1 and never
398	        regress; trimming only drops the oldest retained records.
399	        """
400	        if self.change_retention is None:
401	            return
402	        self._latest_seq += 1
403	        self._changes.append(
404	            {
405	                "seq": self._latest_seq,
406	                "kind": kind,
407	                "window_start_ms": start,
408	                "window_end_ms": start + self.window_ms,
409	                "count": count,
410	                "sum": total,
411	            }
412	        )
413	        overflow = len(self._changes) - self.change_retention
414	        if overflow > 0:
415	            del self._changes[:overflow]
416	
417	    def advance_watermark(self, watermark_ms: int) -> list[dict]:
418	        if self.watermark is not None and watermark_ms < self.watermark:
419	            raise WatermarkRegressionError(
420	                f"watermark {watermark_ms} is below current {self.watermark}"
421	            )
422	        self.watermark = watermark_ms
423	        newly: list[dict] = []
424	        for start in sorted(self._windows):
425	            if start in self._finalized_starts:
426	                continue
427	            end = start + self.window_ms
428	            if watermark_ms >= end + self.allowed_lateness_ms:
429	                count, total = self._windows[start]
430	                newly.append(
431	                    {
432	                        "stream": self.name,
433	                        "window_start_ms": start,
434	                        "window_end_ms": end,
435	                        "count": count,
436	                        "sum": total,
437	                    }
438	                )
439	                self._finalized_starts.add(start)
440	                # The final record of a window always follows every
441	                # upsert of the triggering commit.
442	                self._append_change("final", start, count, total)
443	                if self.lookup_table is not None:
444	                    # Joined groups finalize synchronously with their window,
445	                    # ordered by (lookup_key, label) within it.
446	                    groups = self._joined_windows.pop(start, {})
447	                    for key, group_label in sorted(groups):
448	                        group_count, group_sum = groups[(key, group_label)]
449	                        self._joined_finalized.append(
450	                            {
451	                                "stream": self.name,
452	                                "window_start_ms": start,
453	                                "window_end_ms": end,
454	                                "lookup_key": key,
455	                                "label": group_label,
456	                                "count": group_count,
457	                                "sum": group_sum,
458	                            }
459	                        )
460	        self._finalized.extend(newly)
461	        if self.dedup_retention_ms is not None:
462	            horizon = watermark_ms - self.dedup_retention_ms
463	            self._dedup = {
464	                event_id: kept
465	                for event_id, kept in self._dedup.items()
466	                if kept[0] >= horizon
467	            }
468	        return newly
469	
470	    def results(self) -> list[dict]:
471	        return [dict(row) for row in self._finalized]
472	
473	    def to_snapshot(self) -> dict:
474	        """Serialize this stream as one entry of a version-1 snapshot."""
475	        entry: dict = {
476	            "name": self.name,
477	            "window_ms": self.window_ms,
478	            "allowed_lateness_ms": self.allowed_lateness_ms,
479	            "dedup_retention_ms": self.dedup_retention_ms,
480	            "watermark_ms": self.watermark,
481	            "windows": [
482	                {
483	                    "window_start_ms": start,
484	                    "window_end_ms": start + self.window_ms,
485	                    "count": self._windows[start][0],
486	                    "sum": self._windows[start][1],
487	                }
488	                for start in sorted(self._windows)
489	                if start not in self._finalized_starts
490	            ],
491	            "finalized": sorted(
492	                (dict(row) for row in self._finalized),
493	                key=lambda row: row["window_start_ms"],
494	            ),
495	        }
496	        if self.auto_watermark_lag_ms is not None:
497	            # Automatic streams publish the pair together; manual streams
498	            # keep the historical document shape exactly.
499	            entry["auto_watermark_lag_ms"] = self.auto_watermark_lag_ms
500	            entry["max_event_timestamp_ms"] = self.max_event_timestamp
501	        if self.slide_ms is not None:
502	            # Sliding streams publish the step; documents without it
503	            # restore as tumbling streams.
504	            entry["slide_ms"] = self.slide_ms
505	        if self.lookup_table is not None:
506	            # Joined streams publish the table reference plus the grouped
507	            # state; only format_version 2 documents may carry these.
508	            entry["lookup_table"] = self.lookup_table
509	            joined_open = []
510	            for start in sorted(self._joined_windows):
511	                groups = self._joined_windows[start]
512	                for key, group_label in sorted(groups):
513	                    group_count, group_sum = groups[(key, group_label)]
514	                    joined_open.append(
515	                        {
516	                            "window_start_ms": start,
517	                            "window_end_ms": start + self.window_ms,
518	                            "lookup_key": key,
519	                            "label": group_label,
520	                            "count": group_count,
521	                            "sum": group_sum,
522	                        }
523	                    )
524	            entry["joined_windows"] = joined_open
525	            entry["joined_finalized"] = [dict(row) for row in self._joined_finalized]
526	        if self.dedup_retention_ms is not None:
527	            records = []
528	            for event_id, kept in sorted(self._dedup.items()):
529	                record = {
530	                    "event_id": event_id,
531	                    "timestamp_ms": kept[0],
532	                    "value": kept[1],
533	                }
534	                if self.lookup_table is not None:
535	                    record["lookup_key"] = kept[2]
536	                records.append(record)
537	            entry["dedup_records"] = records
538	        if self.change_retention is not None:
539	            # Change-feed streams publish the config, the cursor and the
540	            # retained records; only format_version 3 documents may carry
541	            # these.
542	            entry["change_retention"] = self.change_retention
543	            entry["latest_seq"] = self._latest_seq
544	            entry["changes"] = [dict(record) for record in self._changes]
545	        return entry
546	
547	    @classmethod
548	    def from_snapshot(
549	        cls,
550	        data: object,
551	        table_names: set[str] | None = None,
552	        allow_change_feed: bool = False,
553	    ) -> "_Stream":
554	        """Rebuild one stream from a snapshot entry or raise SnapshotError.
555	
556	        Every structural and semantic rule is checked and nothing is
557	        repaired: callers get a fully formed stream or nothing. Join
558	        fields (``lookup_table``, ``joined_windows``, ``joined_finalized``)
559	        are only accepted when ``table_names`` is given (a version 2
560	        document); the referenced table must be one of them. Change-feed
561	        fields (``change_retention``, ``latest_seq``, ``changes``) are
562	        only accepted when ``allow_change_feed`` is set (a version 3
563	        document).
564	        """
565	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
566	            raise SnapshotError("stream entry must be an object")
567	        allowed = {
568	            "name",
569	            "window_ms",
570	            "allowed_lateness_ms",
571	            "dedup_retention_ms",
572	            "watermark_ms",
573	            "windows",
574	            "finalized",
575	            "dedup_records",
576	            "auto_watermark_lag_ms",
577	            "max_event_timestamp_ms",
578	            "slide_ms",
579	        }
580	        if table_names is not None:
581	            allowed |= {"lookup_table", "joined_windows", "joined_finalized"}
582	        if allow_change_feed:
583	            allowed |= {"change_retention", "latest_seq", "changes"}
584	        extra = sorted(set(data) - allowed)
585	        if extra:
586	            raise SnapshotError(f"stream entry has unexpected field: {extra[0]}")
587	        required = {
588	            "name",
589	            "window_ms",
590	            "allowed_lateness_ms",
591	            "dedup_retention_ms",
592	            "watermark_ms",
593	            "windows",
594	            "finalized",
595	        }
596	        missing = sorted(required - set(data))
597	        if missing:
598	            raise SnapshotError(f"stream entry missing required field: {missing[0]}")
599	
600	        # The automatic-watermark pair must appear together; a document
601	        # without it restores as a manual stream.
602	        has_lag = "auto_watermark_lag_ms" in data
603	        has_max = "max_event_timestamp_ms" in data
604	        if has_lag != has_max:
605	            raise SnapshotError(
606	                f"stream entry automatic-watermark fields must appear together: "
607	                f"auto_watermark_lag_ms and max_event_timestamp_ms"
608	            )
609	        auto_lag = data.get("auto_watermark_lag_ms") if has_lag else None
610	        if has_lag and (not _is_int(auto_lag) or auto_lag < 0):
611	            raise SnapshotError(
612	                f"stream {data.get('name')!r}: auto_watermark_lag_ms must be a "
613	                f"non-negative integer"
614	            )
615	        max_event_timestamp = data.get("max_event_timestamp_ms") if has_max else None
616	        if has_max and max_event_timestamp is not None and not _is_int(
617	            max_event_timestamp
618	        ):
619	            raise SnapshotError(
620	                f"stream {data.get('name')!r}: max_event_timestamp_ms must be an "
621	                f"integer or null"
622	            )
623	
624	        name = data.get("name")
625	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
626	            raise SnapshotError("stream name must be a non-empty string")
627	        window_ms = data.get("window_ms")
628	        if not _is_int(window_ms) or window_ms <= 0:
629	            raise SnapshotError(f"stream {name!r}: window_ms must be a positive integer")
630	        slide_ms = data.get("slide_ms") if "slide_ms" in data else None
631	        if "slide_ms" in data and (
632	            not _is_int(slide_ms)
633	            or slide_ms <= 0
634	            or slide_ms > window_ms
635	            or window_ms % slide_ms != 0
636	        ):
637	            raise SnapshotError(
638	                f"stream {name!r}: slide_ms must be a positive integer no larger "
639	                f"than window_ms that evenly divides it"
640	            )

990	        """

1003

1005	            data["joined_finalized"],

1007	            window_ms,

1023	            )
